primer: Apar Industries (NSE: APARINDS) leads globally in power conductors, transformer oils, and specialty cables. FY26 sales hit ₹22,902 Cr with a ₹15,025+ Cr backlog and a post-QIP CARE AA; Stable rating. Business quality stays COMPOUNDER_PASS (PASS_WITH_WATCH), yet 67% of Q2 EBITDA growth came from a one-off oil windfall while H1 CFO hit -₹862.63 Cr. With shares in Stage 4 (CAP_REJECTED, -34.99% 28d RS) at 41.83x P/E and a ₹13,800 base target, new capital is REJECTED (TIER_0). For our 18 Zerodha shares, we trim 9 shares immediately and exit the remaining 9 on a bounce or below ₹13,178.14.
